review_kind: Declared Cargo package license metadata inventory and manual expression-level screening; not a source/license-file audit or legal opinion.

scope.all_targets: Resolved locked dependency graph for the current project feature selection, without platform filtering; includes direct and transitive packages and applicable build/proc-macro dependencies across platforms.
scope.linux: Resolve graph filtered to x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu; this is a metadata inventory, not a claim every node is linked into a release binary.
excluded: Vendored or embedded third-party code within crates
Non-Cargo tools, including Toxiproxy and test/development executables
System libraries and Rust standard library/toolchain
Release artifact contents and notice completeness

findings: All 97 third-party package-version records declare a license. The 98-record all-target metadata identity set equals Cargo.lock including the root project.

No unknown identifiers or obvious strong-copyleft expressions were found in this bounded metadata screen. This does not establish that source code or embedded content is correctly described by package metadata.
ctrlc 3.5.2 and serde_urlencoded 0.7.1 use deprecated MIT/Apache-2.0 notation. It is retained verbatim and treated as MIT OR Apache-2.0 for screening only.
All declarations offer a candidate permissive license path; alternatives are not a completed legal election or compliance guarantee.
18 declarations are Unicode-3.0 alone; unicode-ident 1.0.26 requires Unicode-3.0 alongside an MIT or Apache-2.0 choice. The AND condition must not be dropped.
A null license_file field means no such metadata field was declared, not that the upstream package has no license text.
The project Apache-2.0 license does not replace third-party licenses. Preserve actual upstream notices and meet chosen-license obligations for whatever is redistributed.
